contract.description: (2019) What a beautiful day isn't it? No better way to start off the day than with 2 fried eggs, at it appears everyone agrees.

contract.name: Cinco de Oh-no
contract.description: (2019) Cinco de Mayo celebrators partied a little too hard and have depleted pain killer supplies, time to restock!

contract.name: CleanX
contract.description: (2019) To make room for more satellites, we need to clean up space! Over 500,000 pieces of space trash need to be pulled back to earth. So we're building a Graviton Canon!

contract.name: Passive Challenge
contract.description: A competition is being held for producing the most eggs while being rewarded for being as hands off as possible!

contract.name: Defenses
contract.description: (2022) A struggling Mars colony has attacked a neighboring colony out of paranoia - the federation needs materials for defenses and repairs.

contract.name: Study Diet
contract.description: A seemingly limitless number of tests are being taken: SAT, ACT, AP, LSAT, ETC. The latest prep fad is a Superfood Egg diet. Stores are sold out!

contract.name: 3D Printing
contract.description: (2019) 3D printing is blowing up and there are filament shortages all over, Super Material eggs are needed!

contract.name: Power's Out
contract.description: Storms battering parts of the country are leading to sold out home Fusion Egg generators, additional fuel is needed!

contract.name: Eggclipse
contract.description: (2022) Watching the Eclipse from space was so popular this year, multiple space tourism companies need their fuel refilled!

contract.name: Tachy-gone
contract.description: (2020) "Time tourism" broke all records this memorial day depleting tachyon egg inventories, time to help stock back up!

contract.name: Valentine Invitation
contract.description: You have been invited to produce chocolate for Valentines inside a compound of a mysterious candy mogul!

contract.name: Over The Edge
contract.description: (2022) Surging fossil fuel prices are pushing lagging nations to finally switch to renewable clean fuels, like Fusion eggs!

contract.name: Heat Waves
contract.description: (2019) Heat waves are being reported all over the planet, help everyone cool off!

contract.name: LEGO Tower!
contract.description: (2019) Everyone is building LEGO towers. Super Material eggs are needed to form all the bricks! (download LEGO Tower today!)

contract.name: Wanna Get Away
contract.description: The dreary weather and long weekends are depleting space tourism companies fuel reserves. New orders are in!

contract.name: Ion Drive
contract.description: (2020) Aerospace companies need Fusion eggs for an experimental Ion Thruster project.

contract.name: Last Minute
contract.description: (2018) More fireworks are needed ASAP!

contract.name: Bake Sale
contract.description: (2022) The world's largest school district is having the world's largest Bake Sale to solve budget issues. They need supplies!

contract.name: Fab-u-lous
contract.description: The need for computer chips has gone vertical, and a new fabrication method makes use of Super Material Eggs!

contract.name: Fresh Pasta
contract.description: A popular cooking show has kicked off a surge in making fresh pasta at home! Top quality Edible Eggs are in high demand.

contract.name: Engage!
contract.description: (2018) The Federation of planets needs more fuel for their star fleet!

contract.name: Cautious Research
contract.description: Research into new medicines requires heavily regulated Medical Egg production, blowing up your research costs, can you deliver?

contract.name: Egg Day 2018
contract.description: (2018) Some folks like to celebrate Egg Day with a bang!

contract.name: Cesar Chavez
contract.description: While egg farm working conditions are near luxurious, it wasn't always that way. Time tourists are taking a look back to understand one man's important work.

contract.name: R3 Eggs
contract.description: EV Startup Rivihen is starting factory build out for the R3Eggs - their new rally inspired egg powered car - a supplier is needed!

contract.name: Hangover Cure
contract.description: (2019) It's the day after St. Patrick's day and folks had a little too much to drink, hangover cures are out of stock!

contract.name: Tax Headache
contract.description: (2019) It's time to file taxes! Headache cures are in high demand. Help fill the orders!

contract.name: Egg-A-Thon
contract.description: Nonprofits have started selling Eggs to raise money as special tax breaks are now offered to farmers who supply them.

contract.name: Mended Bones
contract.description: (2022) A biomedical company has created a treatment - distilled from Medical Eggs - that treats bone fractures, reducing healing time by 90%!

contract.name: Neuro Threads
contract.description: As neuro-machine interfaces gain popularity, new techniques for spinning the fine connective threads require loads of Super Material Eggs!

contract.name: Orbital Fueling
contract.description: (2020) A new orbital fueling rig has begun operation, it needs copious amounts of Quantum Eggs!

contract.name: All or Nothing
contract.description: (2018) A mysterious investor is looking for a lot of edible eggs. But he wants the full amount or nothing.

contract.name: Pool Heater
contract.description: Bright sunshine has folks headed to the pool despite the cool Spring air. Fusion powered Pool Heaters need fuel to combat the frigid water!

contract.name: Help Australia
contract.description: (2020) Fires in Australia have reached historic size and devastation, Waterballoon eggs are needed! Auxbrain, Inc. has donated to the Australian Red Cross to help.

contract.name: Summer Heat
contract.description: (2019) With summer heat in full swing, AC is running non stop and some power plants need more fuel!

contract.name: Mars Food
contract.description: Mars Settlers are asking courageous Egg Farmers, to come help get their Mars Superfood Eggs farms underway.

contract.name: Easter Rush
contract.description: (2022) After a slow 2021, Easter Egg producers were caught off guard this year by massive orders - more farmers are needed!

contract.name: Made In Space
contract.description: (2020) A space exploration firm is building a spaceship factory.. in space!

contract.name: Tachyon Inflation
contract.description: A dearth Tachyon Eggs has sent prices soaring. Cash in with these contracts!

contract.name: Snack Attack
contract.description: (2020) For an unknown reason baked goods are flying off the shelves and more eggs are needed to restock!

contract.name: Superfood Mystery
contract.description: (2019) A mysterious company is buying incredible amounts of Superfood Eggs, can you meet the demands?

contract.name: Luncheggbles
contract.description: With school about to resume, pre-made school lunches are ramping production, the top ingredient is Superfood eggs!

contract.name: Eggene
contract.description: A company has formulated a 1 atom thick multi-material manufacturing process that uses Super Material eggs as a base - demand is massive!

contract.name: Fusion Headphones
contract.description: Sonegg released new wireless headphones powered by fusion eggs that never need to be recharged!

contract.name: Nostalgia
contract.description: July 14 (2018) is Egg Day around the galaxy and everyone like to celebrate with the egg that started it all...

contract.name: The New Mac Pro!
contract.description: (2019) Apple has placed an huge order of Super Material eggs for the crazy new Mac Pro case!

contract.name: Go Outside
contract.description: A wildly popular video app was recently shut down, leading to a surge in outdoor activities, and bigger appetites.

contract.name: Megg The 4th Be With You
contract.description: (2020) Levitation products and tricks are being cleared out of stores, suppliers need to refill orders!

contract.name: Super Food Drive
contract.description: (2018) Egg Farmers have flocked to high value eggs leaving people hungry! We need some Superfood eggs stat!

contract.name: Folding Screens
contract.description: (2020) While it is unclear who wants a folding screen, at this year's Consumer Electronics Show they were all the rage! Raw materials are needed!

contract.name: Orbital Colony
contract.description: Research is being done to create a permanent human colony in orbit of earth. Incredible amounts of Rocket Fuel are needed!

contract.name: Tricker Treats
contract.description: (2020) Time to help make everyone's favorite Halloween treat!

contract.name: Depleted Reserves
contract.description: (2022) After an extended heat wave, Fusion Egg reserves are nearly depleted, and orders are going out!

contract.name: Ship Building
contract.description: An anomaly in space has been detected they may open new deep space exploration routes. Speculators are ordering fleets of ships to be prepared.

contract.name: Buck 'O Five
contract.description: It's been a few years since Fireworks were so popular on Memorial Day in the states, it has caught suppliers off guard!

contract.name: Super Hot Dogs
contract.description: A new hot dog engineered from Super Material eggs is a huge hit this Memorial Day - Manufacturers need a restock!

contract.name: Fusion Tankers
contract.description: (2018) The world's largest ocean shipping company is putting ultra compact fusion reactors in all their tankers. Long term work available for individual farmers.

contract.name: Moon Storage
contract.description: A forward space exploration base on the moon is hiring local production of Quantum eggs to sustain their Storage needs.

contract.name: Pumpkin Crunch
contract.description: (2018) Pumpkins are in super high demand... leave it to the chickens to deliver the goods!

contract.name: Juneteenth
contract.description: (2022) Time-travel tours are overrun by young kids learning about the road to freedom for Black Americans. More supplies are needed!

contract.name: Leap Year Festival
contract.description: (2019) Leap Year Festivals around the world need Tachyon eggs for various rituals!

contract.name: Dad Recovery
contract.description: During their well deserved special day, Dads the world over did what they do best and pushed it too far, recovery meds are in need!

contract.name: Summer Is Here
contract.description: And it's a hot one! From air conditioning to water park pumps, the electricity demand is huge. Help power the fun!

contract.name: Brain Gain
contract.description: A new gene therapy has been approved that repairs and protects the structures of the brain, nearly eliminating the impacts of age.

contract.name: Cancer Canceller
contract.description: (BONUS) A New CRISPR Therapy can target a wide range of Cancers. Supplies are needed!

contract.name: Paying Up
contract.description: (2023) Large fireworks distributors were hoping prices would ease as July 4th approached, but they stayed high, so now the rush is on!

contract.name: Quantum Blitz
contract.description: (2018) The storage industry is in need of more Quantum Eggs, and they need them fast!

contract.name: tHent
contract.description: A breakout adventure brand is selling a 6 person tent that can fit in a glovebox, employing a Super Material Egg derived material!

contract.name: Carbhen Fiber
contract.description: Increasing demands for composite materials have led to a specialized egg for this purpose, qualified suppliers are needed!

contract.name: School Supplies
contract.description: (2022) Shippers are having to contend with an unexpectedly high amount of school supplies to deliver, quantum technology is required!

contract.name: Henergy Bar
contract.description: A Superfood derived protein/energy bar is the top pick for outdoor enthusiasts. They are looking for new suppliers

contract.name: Athlete A/C
contract.description: A misguided decision to deprive Olympic athletes of air conditioning has many teams installing Fusion Egg powered units, they need low cost supplies!

contract.name: Hydrogen Dreams
contract.description: (2020) After a hydrogen fuel cell car company was revealed to be a fraud, Rivihen Fusion car sales are surging!

contract.name: Carbon Moon
contract.description: Carbon fiber, once an fossil fuel derived product, is finding more heavy use off world due to the new means of production

contract.name: Arteggmis I
contract.description: (2022) A new rocket system is about to undergo a lengthy testing regime, extensive Rocket Fuel Egg reserves are being ordered.

contract.name: Kids Choice
contract.description: Whether its the return to school or the start of fall sports, high protein kid breakfasts like an egg sandwich are driving demand for the classic!

contract.name: Egg Brain
contract.description: (2022) A new Medical Egg Based supplement is being recommended for everyone over 50 to maintain brain heath - much less expensive than Immortality Egg treatments!

contract.name: A Clever Solution
contract.description: As drought wreaks havoc on agriculture, farmers are looking for water in unusual places... (2018)

contract.name: Muscle Mesh
contract.description: A new humanoid bot maker, is using Super Material eggs to create a mesh that contracts and relaxes just like a organic muscle!

contract.name: CyberSteel
contract.description: (2019) Despite controversial styling the new Truck from Teslegg has become a must have for Egg Farmers. More raw materials are needed!

contract.name: Coco Shortage
contract.description: (2021) The time between Easter and Mother's day is usually slow for chocolate, but not this year!

contract.name: Goodbye Summer
contract.description: The final Summer 2024 Contract naturally is our favorite way to cool off during heat waves

contract.name: Launch Window
contract.description: The launch window for Mars trips is coming up quick, and launch providers are securing their fuel supplies.

contract.name: Billionaire Boon
contract.description: (2021) Space Tourism companies are multiplying, and so are new larger orders for fuel!

contract.name: New Fibers
contract.description: A very competitive Formula E season has the teams redesigning parts at a rapid pace. Each has huge orders for Carbon Fiber eggs!

contract.name: A/C DC
contract.description: (2021) As a heat wave grips the northern hemisphere, everyone sets their AC to 70 degrees knowing you'll provide the clean energy fuel!

contract.name: Eggutane
contract.description: (2022) A new acne treatment made from Medical eggs has been approved. 100% effective with no side effects! Supplies are needed.

contract.name: Eggetarians
contract.description: (2021) A food movement of people who only eat Edible eggs has led to shortages in supermarkets!

contract.name: Summer Construction
contract.description: (2023) With a long winter ending, the Summer construction rush is set to begin. Supplier are loading up on raw materials!

contract.name: Ultimate Counters
contract.description: The search for the ultimate kitchen counter material is over. The new resin is being adopted by designers all over, and demand is huge!

contract.name: Pumpkin Art
contract.description: (2022) Pumpkin decorating contests are the activity of choice for kids this year, stores are paying a premium for pumpkins!

contract.name: New Civilization
contract.description: (2018) A group of explorers are setting out to find new worlds, new civilizations. They are in need of fuel!

contract.name: Tally Ho!
contract.description: (2021) Wooden boat building has exploded in popularity inspired by projects like Tally Ho, causing a surge in demand for Super Material derived wood products!

contract.name: Frugal Easter
contract.description: (2023) With edible eggs prices so high, consumers are turning to pre-decorated Easter Eggs for the savings!

contract.name: Landing Towers
contract.description: Not long after proof of concept, nearly all launch providers are switching from landing legs to catch towers, massive construction projects are underway!

contract.name: Stockpile Fireworks
contract.description: (2019) Early orders indicate this is going to be a big 4th of July in the states! Time to start stockpiling fireworks!

contract.name: Pumpkin Juice
contract.description: In part because of a popular book series, and in part due to the pumpkin spice craze, Pumpkin Juice is driving mega pumpkin demand!

contract.name: SpaceEggs
contract.description: (2018) Spaceflight is booming due to re-usable rockets. Help fill the demand with this contract.

contract.name: Getting Ready
contract.description: With 4th of July (2018) nearing in the States, scientists have found a new way to meet the demand for fireworks...

contract.name: TRS
contract.description: (2023) The Formula Egg Racing series has added a new features called the 'Tachyon Rewind System' (TRS) which allows drivers to rewind time a few seconds to correct a mistake. Teams need suppliers!

contract.name: Candy Drone
contract.description: Drone delivery is taking off, and a local service offering  to delivery halloween candy needs raw supplies to fill orders!

contract.name: Quantum Ballot Box
contract.description: (2020) The new Quantum Ballot boxes can securely store millions of ballots. Make sure you (or your parents) are planning to vote!

contract.name: World Record Egg
contract.description: (2019) With a simple picture of an Egg becoming the most liked social media post, demand for the classic is booming!

contract.name: Good Ol' Fusion
contract.description: (2020) A new orbital outpost needs fuel! It's a good o' fashion fusion supply contract!

contract.name: Nothing Is Happening
contract.description: Absolutely nothing of any significance is happening this week, so folks are distorting time to zip through the week, but they need supplies!

contract.name: Video Games
contract.description: (2020) With folks playing more PC and Console games than ever before, home energy needs are up!

contract.name: Specialized
contract.description: With the demand for chemical batteries expected to grow exponentially for the foreseeable future, a specialized Lithium Egg was needed...

contract.name: Infinite Slopes
contract.description: A new ski resort has opened with quantum lifts that displace you to the top of the run, allowing for non stop skiing!
